title: Let the owner rename a document
objective: Let the document's owner rename it. PATCH /api/documents/:id with { title } renames it: the title is trimmed; a blank title is refused with 400 { error: 'title_required' } and nothing changes; over 120 characters is refused with 400 { error: 'title_too_long' }; anyone but the owner gets 403 { error: 'owner_only' }. The new name shows everywhere the document is listed (library list, document page, API). On the document page, the owner's title carries data-editable="true" (inline edit: Enter saves, Escape cancels); a teammate's does not.
acceptance: The owner renames d1 and the new, trimmed name shows on the library list, the document page and GET /api/documents/d1
A blank name is not saved (400) and the old name stays
A name over 120 characters is refused (400)
Only the owner sees the title as editable
plan_summary: A PATCH route in api.mjs with a renameDocument rule in store.mjs; data-editable on the h1 for the owner.
